steps.en: The officer has already marked the notices of work order IDs with a special indicator
steps.id: Officer sudah menandai notice di work order dengan indikator khusus
steps.why_en: No indicator is ever set on notices; the work order step before it is not built either.
steps.why_id: Indikator tidak pernah dipasang pada notice; langkah work order sebelumnya juga belum ada.

steps.en: OCMS sends the special indicator to PLUS
steps.id: OCMS mengirim indikator khusus ke PLUS
steps.why_en: Only PLUS calling OCMS exists; OCMS never sends anything to PLUS.
steps.why_id: Yang ada hanya PLUS memanggil OCMS; OCMS tidak pernah mengirim apa pun ke PLUS.

steps.en: OCMS sends the work order validity period to PLUS
steps.id: OCMS mengirim masa berlaku work order ke PLUS
steps.why_en: No validity period is stored or sent anywhere.
steps.why_id: Masa berlaku tidak disimpan maupun dikirim ke mana pun.

steps.en: PLUS users can tell an appeal came from an offender in the work order
steps.id: PLUS user bisa tahu appeal datang dari offender di work order
steps.why_en: PLUS receives no work order marker, so it cannot tell.
steps.why_id: PLUS tidak menerima penanda work order, jadi tidak bisa tahu.
